name: Fantastical
description:
Fantastical is a calendar and tasks app that brings work, personal, family, and other schedules into a unified view. Its central advantage is seeing connected calendars and task sources together, then using flexible views and natural-language entry to manage a busy day without constantly switching providers.

Connect the accounts already in use, add events in ordinary language, and use calendar sets to show the relevant slice of life at a given moment. This is useful when a work calendar, an iCloud calendar, a shared family schedule, and task lists all need to inform the same decisions.

Fantastical is more capable than the built-in calendar, but that also makes its premium features, account connections, and subscription worth evaluating against your actual schedule. It should make planning clearer, not become another place that requires duplicate maintenance.

## Features

- Connect Google Calendar, Microsoft 365, Exchange, iCloud, CalDAV, Todoist, and other supported sources in one interface.
- Create events using natural-language input such as a meeting name and time instead of completing every field manually.
- Use calendar sets to switch quickly between different groups of calendars, such as work and home.
- View tasks with the calendar through supported task-service integrations.
- Use the current Mac, Windows, iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch, and Vision Pro apps according to the features available on each platform.

## Where it fits

Fantastical fits people who manage several calendars and want a calmer, unified planning view. It is especially useful when changing context between work and personal life is a daily problem.

It cannot repair inconsistent source calendars or eliminate the need to choose a single place for each event. Check the current free and Premium feature split before moving a critical workflow.
